capabilities.name: Qualified managed commands
capabilities.reason: Managed commands require an exact declared daemon release profile.

capabilities.name: Lossless tilde projection
capabilities.reason: Six ordered substitutions encode delimiters, backslashes and dollar signs.

capabilities.name: Argument-token FORMAT quoting
capabilities.reason: q/a is introduced in 3.7; older profiles use the tested tilde codec.

capabilities.name: Additional command-output escaping
capabilities.reason: Reverse one VIS output layer before decoding the tilde field.

capabilities.name: Classic layout decoding
capabilities.reason: Classic layouts remain available for old layouts and unnegotiated control clients.

capabilities.name: JSON-subset layout decoding
capabilities.reason: JSON layouts include floating placements in the current profile.

capabilities.name: Owned control connection
capabilities.reason: Control framing is available at the support floor.

capabilities.name: New-layout control negotiation
capabilities.reason: Enable new-layouts explicitly before interpreting new control layouts.

capabilities.name: Floating panes
capabilities.reason: Floating panes and their coordinates are available starting in 3.7.

capabilities.name: Modal panes
capabilities.reason: Modal panes and modal-window fields require 3.8.

capabilities.name: Complete buffer FORMAT value
capabilities.reason: Use save-buffer when buffer_full is unavailable.

capabilities.name: Binary buffer capture
capabilities.reason: Binary save-buffer capture is separate from FORMAT framing.

capabilities.name: Mirrored main layouts
capabilities.reason: Mirrored main-horizontal and main-vertical layouts require 3.5.

capabilities.name: Broken percent split option
capabilities.reason: split-window -p is broken in 3.4; use the explicit -l percentage form.

capabilities.name: Broken break-pane naming
capabilities.reason: tmux 3.7 ignores explicit break-pane names and dereferences a null name in the unnamed multi-pane path; refuse break-pane before dispatch.

capabilities.name: Rejected separators in names
capabilities.reason: tmux 3.7 rejects colon and dot names; validate their capability before dispatch.

capabilities.name: Literal session name separators
capabilities.reason: Literal dot and colon in session names require 3.7a; earlier releases replace or reject them.

capabilities.name: Literal window name separators
capabilities.reason: Literal dot and colon in window names are supported unless the declared separator defect applies.

capabilities.name: Explicit empty pane flag
capabilities.reason: Explicit empty split panes use -E from 3.7; older releases require the declared empty-argument adapter.

capabilities.name: Empty window creation
capabilities.reason: Empty window creation requires the new-window -E flag from 3.8.

capabilities.name: Printed identity for single-pane break
capabilities.reason: Breaking the only pane prints its returned identity from 3.6; older releases need an explicit scoped identity acquisition.

capabilities.name: Floating pane placement and stacking
capabilities.reason: Floating pane position and stack changes require move-pane placement flags from 3.8.

capabilities.name: Control job output
capabilities.reason: Foreground run-shell job output is delivered to the command client from 3.5; earlier releases send it to pane view mode. This does not guarantee shell-output framing.

capabilities.name: Menu appearance and initial choice
capabilities.reason: Menu border, style, selected style and initial choice flags are available from 3.4.

capabilities.name: Menu mouse selection without a mouse trigger
capabilities.reason: The display-menu -M flag enables mouse selection without a triggering mouse event from 3.5.

capabilities.name: Popup closes on any key
capabilities.reason: The display-popup -k flag requests close on any key from 3.6.

capabilities.name: Reset flags while modifying a popup
capabilities.reason: The display-popup -N flag resets existing popup flags from 3.6; omitted flags otherwise preserve the existing popup policy.

capabilities.name: Single prompt with literal commas
capabilities.reason: The command-prompt -l flag retains commas in one prompt and initial input from 3.6.

capabilities.name: Projected key binding metadata
capabilities.reason: Key table, key, repeat, note and native command source can be projected with list-keys -F from 3.7.
